I read the review's regression lock, TestACheckCompareOfADeployRunStillRunningWakesNothingUntilItCompletes, against the status gate. observations: Wording only (Fast-follow class): the outbox logs 'outbox check compare found a deploy after the merge; the check is woken' for every job that applied. It also logs this when the workflow then keeps or ignores the wake, or takes it as a duplicate. The build compare path already does the same. The workflow's own woken/kept/ignored line records the decision.

Envoy's normalizer drops a workflow_run whose pull_requests is not empty (seen live on pull_request run 40218586433), so a deploy only wakes a check through a run with no pull request attached. A push run on main after a squash merge has none (all real release.yaml runs I used).

Round 2: the gate finishes a not-completed row without retrying, so a genuine completion whose REST read still said in_progress would be lost. Measured against production Envoy, this did not happen in 8 of 8 deliveries (REST already said completed when each envelope arrived). This is evidence from 8 samples, not a guarantee.
